guide.spacings_desc: Definitions for Spacings and Border Radius to maintain consistent layouts and shapes.
guide.spacings_focus_desc: The stroke width and offset spacing of the outline displayed upon focus to ensure accessibility (such as clarifying the current location during keyboard operation).
guide.spacings_guideline_1: The base 1rem follows the browser standard (typically 16px).
guide.spacings_guideline_2: Use CSS variables like var(--spacing-md) for spacings; do not use direct numerical values.
guide.spacings_guideline_3: Use different border radii depending on the component size (Button: sm/md, Card: lg).
guide.spacings_margin_desc: Use CSS variables like `var(--spacing-md)`, do not hardcode values.
guide.spacings_radius_desc: Use according to component size (Button: sm/md, Card: lg).
guide.spacings_no_hardcode_desc: Always use these tokens for `margin` / `padding` / `gap`; never hardcode raw values like `8px` or `12px`. Even when asked to "use an 8px base", map to the nearest token (8px → `--wim-spacing-md`, 16px → `--wim-spacing-2xl`). This scale is intentionally compact (based on a Major Second-like ratio), so some steps are non-integer — relying on tokens keeps spacing consistent and theme-safe.
guide.spacings_semantic_aliases_desc: Do not use value-based scale tokens directly in components. Use the following role-based aliases instead.
guide.density_desc: Global control density remaps heights and paddings for form controls and dense data surfaces without changing layout spacing tokens.
guide.density_modes_desc: Density is selected with `data-density` on `<html>` (or any ancestor). The default is comfortable.
guide.density_comfortable_when: Marketing pages, settings, and everyday forms.
guide.density_comfortable_effect: Standard control heights (e.g. md = 42px) and roomy table cells.
guide.density_compact_when: Dashboards, admin tables, and information-dense tools.
guide.density_compact_effect: Tighter control heights (e.g. md = 36px), control paddings, switches, and table cells.
guide.density_usage_desc: Call `setWimDensity` or set the attribute yourself. Nested scopes can override a parent density.
guide.density_tokens_desc: These CSS custom properties change under `[data-density="compact"]`. Field, button, list, and table chrome that reference them (Input, Textarea, Button, SegmentedControl, Menu, Table, …) update automatically.
guide.density_stable_desc: These stay stable so page layout and identity chrome do not collapse:
guide.density_storybook_hint: In Storybook, use the Density toolbar control, or open Token → Density for a side-by-side demo.

perf.animation_desc: For components involving continuous or complex animations, we use the CSS `will-change` property to give the browser a hint for optimization.
perf.animation_micro_interactions_desc: Applied to small but frequent interactions like `Switch` toggles and `Accordion` expansions to ensure lag-free feedback.
perf.animation_note_desc: Use sparingly as it consumes memory and GPU resources. Avoid using on too many small elements simultaneously.
perf.resource_desc: In the `Image` component, we've introduced a `priority` prop. When set to `true`, it applies `fetchpriority="high"` to the underlying `img` tag.
perf.resource_usage_desc: For the largest image above-the-fold (LCP - Largest Contentful Paint).
perf.resource_benefit_desc: Informs the browser to prioritize this image over other non-critical resources.
